topic: What Questions to Ask a Lender Before Signing
objective: Provide a practical checklist of questions before finalising a facility.

slides.subheadline: A short list, asked every time.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Before signing any facility, a handful of direct questions cover the essentials: total cost, repayment flexibility, what happens if circumstances change, and what security or guarantees are involved. Asking them every time builds a habit worth keeping.

slides.headline: Why it matters
bullet_points: What is the total cost, including all fees?
Is the rate fixed or variable?
What security or guarantees are required?
What happens if I want to repay early?
slides.visual_concept: Matching thin gold line icons on navy, arranged in a simple vertical list.
slides.image_prompt: Create exactly one Instagram carousel slide. The entire canvas is one slide. slides.headline: Key things to know
bullet_points: Get answers in writing, not just verbally
Compare answers across more than one lender
A reluctance to answer clearly is worth noting
Take time before signing — don't feel rushed

caption:
A handful of direct questions, asked consistently before signing anything, cover most of what actually matters: total cost, flexibility, security, and what happens if plans change.

Making this a habit, rather than a one-off exercise, protects you across every facility you take on, not just the first one.
